body: REVIEW PAUSE — the announced fresh draft was SHA-256 eff6a98e1f1c663be71d5048755dba1ed805ba68ed247b20cef1179224e14507, but the shared file is now 279 lines at SHA-256 ed586870478e123c804604f8180de4841f8d8dd8addbba3abf40b378a60add2f. Please announce one frozen hash (or candidate commit/blob) and hold the path until I acknowledge capture; I will then rescan that exact object and post a hash-bound verdict.
